description: Get single batch details by uniqueName: stock/variant, mfg/expiry, days remaining,. Part of the All APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint). Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: createdAt. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

stockUniqueNames.description: Array of stock unique names values. Optional.

variantUniqueNames.description: Array of variant unique names values. Optional.

warehouseUniqueNames.description: Array of warehouse unique names values. Optional.

batchUniqueNames.description: Array of batch unique names values. Optional.

batchNames.description: Array of batch names values. Optional.

batchNumbers.description: Array of batch numbers values. Optional.

available.description: When true, applies the available filter or flag. Optional.

expiredOnly.description: When true, applies the expired only filter or flag. Optional.

archive.description: When true, applies the archive filter or flag. Optional.

includeArchived.description: When true, applies the include archived filter or flag. Optional.

inventoryType.description: Inventory type. Allowed values: PRODUCT, SERVICE, FIXED_ASSETS. Optional.
